safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports shortness of breath while running.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention shortness of breath specifically while running/exertion.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting that dyspnea occurs with exertion (running) can blunt assessment of symptom severity, functional limitation, and triggers, which may affect asthma control grading and urgency of escalation. In an acute asthma context this is clinically relevant but unlikely by itself to directly cause major harm if other severity markers are captured.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Generated facts do not mention wheeze/wheezing.
